Hey everyone! We’re building Aetherium, a completely free game made by fans of browser strategy games, for fans of the genre.

It’s the year 2300. Centuries after a nuclear war, two factions are fighting for survival on Earth. The Terrans rely on infantry, armored vehicles, and aircraft, while the Aetherians field living armies of swarms and siege creatures. Pick a side and establish your settlement on a satellite map of the real world.

Build, explore, and fight. Expand your settlement, research technologies, and raise an army. Send expeditions in search of aetherium crystals, explore the ruins of the old world, and join forces with other players to launch coordinated attacks. The world keeps running while you’re offline, so timing matters when you send your troops away.

Lead your settlement as an Overseer or an Archon. Your faction determines which of these two roles you take on, and you choose a profession for your leader. As your settlement grows, you develop both your base and the person in charge of it, with a profession that lets you specialize the way you lead.

Jam a rival settlement’s radar. Launch a cyberattack to disrupt their radar and make it harder for them to monitor the area around their settlement.

We’re looking for closed beta testers. The beta will run for about a month. This is an early build and the artwork is AI-generated. We’re focusing on gameplay mechanics and balance at this stage, so the visuals may change as development continues.

If you’d like to try it, join our Discord and let us know you’re interested in the beta. We’d love to hear how your first settlements goes.



Game site: [https://aetherium.hs.vc/](https://aetherium.hs.vc/)
